CREATE TABLE [OM].[OM_WORKFLOW_RUN](
WORKFLOW_RUN_ID INT NOT NULL,
WORKFLOW_NAME VARCHAR(30),
PIPELINE_RUNID VARCHAR(36),
STATUS_ID INT,
START_DATETIME DATETIME,
END_DATETIME DATETIME,
CREATE_DATETIME DATETIME
)

CREATE PROCEDURE d360.SP_WORKFLOW_START  @pipeline_runid VARCHAR(36), @source VARCHAR(30)
AS
BEGIN
---START WORKFLOW
INSERT INTO [OM].[OM_WORKFLOW_RUN] (WORKFLOW_RUN_ID,WORKFLOW_NAME,PIPELINE_RUNID,START_DATETIME,END_DATETIME,STATUS_ID,CREATE_DATETIME)
SELECT  ROW_NUMBER() OVER(ORDER BY (SELECT NULL))+ (SELECT ISNULL(MAX(WORKFLOW_RUN_ID),0) FROM [OM].[OM_WORKFLOW_RUN]) 
,WORKFLOW_NAME
,@pipeline_runid
,CAST(SYSDATETIMEOFFSET() AT TIME ZONE 'Singapore Standard Time' AS datetime)
,NULL
,(SELECT STATUS_ID FROM OM.OM_STATUS WHERE STATUS = 'RUNNING')
,CAST(SYSDATETIMEOFFSET() AT TIME ZONE 'Singapore Standard Time' AS datetime)
FROM OM.OM_WORKFLOWS WHERE SOURCE_SYSTEM_CODE = @source 
END


SELECT * FROM OM.OM_WORKFLOWS

CREATE PROCEDURE d360.SP_WORKFLOW_END @pipeline_runid VARCHAR(36)
AS
BEGIN
---END WORKFLOW
UPDATE [OM].[OM_WORKFLOW_RUN] SET STATUS_ID = (SELECT STATUS_ID FROM OM.OM_STATUS WHERE STATUS = 'SUCCESSFUL'), END_DATETIME = CAST(SYSDATETIMEOFFSET() AT TIME ZONE 'Singapore Standard Time' AS datetime) WHERE PIPELINE_RUNID = @pipeline_runid; 
END


select * from [OM].[OM_WORKFLOW_RUN]
